incident-bot: RCA published for incident 'gpu-firmware-timeout' — https://intranet.redwood/rca/1791005555
Summary: Several Dedicated pools experienced intermittent job timeouts when GPUs entered a rare firmware sleep state during prolonged batch writes. Impact: degraded throughput and ~30-60s timeouts for some customer requests over a ~4 hour window. Root cause: a combination of a firmware power-management edge case on newer GPU images and our assumption that a soft-reset was always sufficient to recover. Immediate mitigation: paused deployments to affected GPU image families and added a host-level watchdog to force hard-reset on repeated soft-reset failures.

Yara: RCA is up. Please review 'Mitigations' and 'Action items'. Owners called out: 1) infra: add firmware-aware recovery path + force-cycle fallback (Devon) 2) release: block risky GPU images from Dedicated pools until canary passes (Priya) 3) runtime: add a retry with increased backoff and explicit watchdog logging (Oleg) 4) support: notify impacted customers and offer credits (Logan).

Devon: I'll implement a firmware-aware recovery flow that attempts soft-reset once, then a forced power-cycle if the watchdog sees the GPU unresponsive. ETA Tue EOD. Need guidance on safe power-cycle API for on-prem hosts?

Priya: Blocking image families in Dedicated: I'll add a deployment guard and a canary tag that requires a 48h soak with synthetic batch traffic. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Oleg: Adding explicit retry with exponential backoff and emitting a "gpu_recovery_attempt" event so we can correlate failures. Will add a metric and a log marker for easier triage. ETA Wed.

Logan: I'll prepare customer-facing notes and a list of impacted customer IDs. We'll send targeted notices and apply billing credits where SLA impact occurred.

Yara: Minimal repro used in lab (short snippet):
```
# small harness to produce long batch writes and trigger sleep window
python tools/batch_stress.py --qps 50 --batch-size 64 --duration 600
```
This reproduced the firmware timeout after sustained write pressure in staging.

Devon: Branch for force-cycle fallback: https://git.redwood/repo/1200 — implements watchdog + hard power-cycle path. Running CI and a 6h soak in staging.

Oleg: PR for retry/backoff + metrics: https://git.redwood/repo/1201. Adds a 5-60s exponential retry and emits recovery events to tracing.

Priya: Release guard PR: https://git.redwood/repo/1202 — prevents promotion of new GPU image families into Dedicated unless canary tag is green for 48h.

Yara: Checkpoint scheduled Friday 08:30 UTC to review staging soak, canary status, and customer notifications. Invite sent. :calendar:

Logan: Customer notifications drafted and review requested: https://docs.redwood/incident/1791005555/notice. Will send after we confirm remediation in staging.

Yara: Action board updated: https://kanban.redwood/board/rca-1791005555. Please attach PRs, update statuses, and move cards when things merge.

Devon: Early staging soak shows watchdog triggers and successful force-cycles; recovery rate improved and timeouts dropped to baseline. Will continue 24h soak.

Yara: Thanks everyone for the fast response. We'll close the incident channel but keep this thread as the authoritative follow-up. If you see new regressions, ping @Yara and @Priya to reopen. :white_check_mark:
